title: Chevrolet Tahoe Engines by Year (1995–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet Tahoe by year, 1995–2026: the 5.7 V8 and 6.5 diesel, the Vortec and EcoTec3 V8s, the hybrid and the 3.0 Duramax.
intro: Chevrolet renamed the full-size two-door Blazer the Tahoe for 1995 and added a four-door that year. Yukon-only engines are not listed.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: GMT400
intro: The 5.7 V8, TBI in 1995 and Vortec from 1996, and the 6.5 turbodiesel in the two-door 4WD.

generations.name: GMT800
intro: The 4.8 and 5.3 Vortec V8s, with a FlexFuel 5.3 from 2002.

generations.name: GMT900
intro: The 4.8, 5.3 and 6.2 V8s and the 6.0 two-mode hybrid.

generations.name: K2XX
intro: The 5.3 EcoTec3 V8, with the 6.2 in the RST from 2018.

generations.name: T1
intro: The 5.3 and 6.2 V8s and the 3.0 Duramax inline-six diesel.
